meta.title: Mastering Email Marketing: From Basics to Expert Techniques
meta.author: Alicia Brandt

sentences: **Email marketing** is a powerful tool for digital marketing, offering low **costs**, full **control**, and precise **targeting**.

By using email service providers like **GetResponse**, businesses can easily automate their campaigns, create professional emails, and measure their success, making it ideal for reaching both existing and new audiences effectively.
With emails being an **owned medium**, businesses have full **control** over these communications, maximizing **engagement** and ensuring better **returns** on investment.
The use of **automation** helps in delivering targeted content efficiently, while also allowing integration with other **marketing channels** to enhance reach.
GetResponse **provides** a **free** plan for up to **500 contacts** with essential **email marketing** features.
Their paid **plans depend** on the size of the **email list** and **features** needed.
Basic starts at **$15/month** for up to 1,000 subscribers, Plus at **$49/month**, and Professional at **$99/month**.
Mailchimp, a popular tool, **integrates well** with other tools but **becomes less cost-effective** as needs grow.
Their **free plan** is useful initially but lacks **essential actions** like scheduling.
The Essentials plan is **$9.99/month** for 500 contacts, Standard at **$14.99/month**, and Premium at **$299/month**.
**A/B Testing** helps you find the best email campaigns by experimenting.
Use **spam checker tools** to ensure your emails don’t end up in junk folders.
Also, avoid buying email lists as they can harm your long-term reputation.
**GetResponse** has a rich history, starting as the first autoresponder in 1997.
Today, it supports over **350K customers worldwide**, offering automated tools for businesses.
Their pricing is based on list size, with the cheapest at **$15/month** for up to 1000 contacts, including discounts for longer billing periods.
